It was especially fun to watch the children, dressed as celestial beings, and their comical facial expressions. It was a memorable social event, which concluded with residential lights being switched off to watch the partial lunar eclipse, a most amazing celestial event.

The original proposal was for medical professionals, including dental therapists, to occasionally travel from the city. The refusal of this proposal resulted in national advertising for professionals to reside and work at the rural hospital.

However, the discovery of a deposit of rare yellow ochre just a kilometre from the homestead, turned his fortunes around. The ochre was determined to be of a very high calibre and in high demand within the cosmetic industry. Eager to profit the farmer immediately began mining the ochre. However, what began as a small mine, a few metres square, soon grew to consume acres of his farmland. The farmer was not concerned. Previously his farm had only ever provided a meagre income, but now his ochre mine had made him extremely wealthy. The only negative was the unsightly mine just a kilometre from his homestead, and the litres of water needed to keep the mine functioning.

passages.c: After earnest research I have discovered it is indeed true that the early bird catches the earthworm. In the early morning the earth is cool and moist and the earthworm wriggles to the surface, yearning for the warmth of the sun. The bird that begins its search for food in these early hours will soon learn how easy it is to pluck the earthworm from the earth. However, the bird that procrastinates and waits until the sun is high in the sky may yearn for the tasty earthworm, but despite earnest searching, it will be disappointed. You may have heard it quoted that it pays to wait for a pearl to grow. But my research shows you need to start early to capture the earthworm!

The circus had previously visited the town twice before, but five years had passed since the last show. The people were thrilled to have a chance to see the new magic show by the gentle gypsy. They perched on the edge of their seats in silence as the gypsy did an exaggerated bow. Watching intently as the gypsy arranged three tiny mice on the edge of the table, the crowd held their breath. Then suddenly the circus tent erupted in applause. With a flick of the gypsy's cape, the mice had disappeared and were replaced by a huge elephant.

passages.c: Our brief sojourn in the rainforest of Peru was amazing. As a journalist I was dedicated to keeping an accurate record of our experiences in a journal. Our unfortunate arrival in the midst of a tropical thunderstorm forced a landing on the stormy estuary. After wading ashore, our packs and clothing saturated, we were greeted by a warm fire and a sumptuous feast. I will not perpetuate the idea that deep-fried tarantula is a delicacy, spider in any form should not be consumed! Over the following days we continued our journey deep into the rainforest courtesy of the native's canoes. The virtue of travel by river was obvious as we encountered dense, impenetrable jungle. By mutual agreement we extended our journey to allow a visit to the gold statue situated in the heart of the jungle. It truly was the journey of a century!

passages.c: Mr Legion, a graduate of the prestigious international university recently relocated to the Mandurah region. His dream to build an educational facility in the region was contagious and soon had the support of the local community. The plans for the facility reflected the grandeur of ancient Greek architecture and the nostalgia Mr Legion felt for his European homeland. The grandeur of the proposed architecture attracted some resistance from the residents who were concerned that it was not reflective of the Mandurah region. In an effort to demonstrate his allegiance to his new home nation, Mr Legion agreed to change the plans for the facility to reflect the local region. The Mandurah Institute of Learning will educate the next generation of graduates in the fields of philosophy and religion. It may one day become a prestigious university, right here in the heart of Mandurah.

passages.c: The Eureka Stockade was the result of a feud between the Victorian government and the miners of Ballarat. The miners' argument centred around their objection to the excessive mining license fees, the brutality of policemen when collecting the fees and the fact that the miners did not have the right to vote. Between 1851-1854 the feuding increased with protests, the burning of licenses and the burning of the Eureka Hotel. When government troops were sent to quell this uprising, the miners took up arms. They intended to fight to defend what they saw as their human rights and liberties. The Eureka stockade was built and a blue flag with the southern cross inscribed was raised. This flag is still used by unions today as a symbol of protest. When soldiers attacked at dawn, the 150 miners began a futile and brief attempt to fight back. The casualties were calculated at thirty miners and six soldiers killed. Although unsuccessful, the miners' uprising did accelerate reforms with the license fees abolished and replaced with an annual miner's fee which served a dual purpose, giving miners the right to vote. A popular leader of the miners' union, Peter Lalor went on to enter parliament.

passages.c: I have always enjoyed snow skiing above all other sports. Previous skiing holidays have been tremendously enjoyable, especially those in which I discovered secret paths of fresh powder. However, my recent trip to Torpedo Mountain was nothing short of a catastrophe. When I woke the first day with a moderate fever I should have realised a day on the slopes was a recipe for disaster. But reluctant to loose even one day of my premium mountain pass I strapped on my skis and began the descent. Unfortunately, my ambition to conquer the black run was not equal to my sick body's ability and I soon found myself out of control. I tried valiantly to stop, to avoid the other skiers, but instead I crashed into a media tent causing quite a fiasco. I think my next holiday will be a safari to Africa!

passages.c: An encyclopaedia is a fascinating read. In this book you can learn about the aetiology of rare and exotic diseases with terrible symptoms like diarrhoea or ischaemia. There are tales of Caesars who ruled with cruelty and the phoenix rising from the ashes. You can discover the world of archaeology or palaeontology as you read about dinosaurs and ancient artefacts. If you are interested in medicine, there are articles on haematology, orthopaedic surgery and paediatric nursing. You can see the development of a foetus, understand how coeliac disease develops and discover what it is to have haemophilia. But perhaps the most interesting articles are those that describe the microscopic world of the algae and amoeba. The possibilities of what you may discover in an encyclopaedia are endless.

In addition, he would enjoy an increase in energy; an advantage of consuming healthy food. Michael is to be admired for adopting the new diet without complaint. He still craved chocolate, but admitted he felt so much better when he adhered to the diet with discipline.

passages.c: In the case of a severe burn, I must impress upon you the importance of immediate immersion in cold running water.
